title: Allergen Lookup Tool
description: Get allergen and ingredient data for a specific menu item. CRITICAL: Use before any allergy discussion. Never guess allergen status.

description.const: Get allergen and ingredient info for a menu item

properties_comment.idempotence: GET operation; idempotent; same input → same allergen data
properties_comment.usage_rule: ALWAYS call this tool before discussing allergies. Never guess allergen status from memory.
properties_comment.response_handling: Disclose ingredient data, state 'I can't guarantee cross-contact', offer human_handoff
properties_comment.safety_critical: If allergy mentioned, this tool is NON-NEGOTIABLE. Failure to call = safety violation.
properties_comment.fda_allergens: Big 9: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame
properties_comment.eu_allergens: 14 allergens required in EU: add celery, mustard, sulphites, lupin, molluscs
